prompt:
Square 1:1 editorial magazine-style Meta ad. Solid charcoal almost-black background #202326. All content left-aligned with wide margins and abundant negative space. No photographs, illustrations, logos, buttons, icons, emoji, or digital-ad chrome.

Top: classic high-contrast serif type similar to Times, all caps, white:
SI SOS
COACH
Large, strong presence.

Immediately below, same serif family, much smaller, lowercase, white or very light gray:
te queremos en orlis.

Below that, the signature visual: a short paragraph split into several lines, each line individually highlighted with a white or very light-gray rectangle that hugs the exact width of that line, like selected text in a document. Dark charcoal or black type inside the highlights. Exact Spanish copy, perfectly spelled:
Convertí lo que sabés en ingresos mensuales.
Tus alumnos pasan a ser una membresía.
Cobrás todos los meses por lo que ya enseñás.
The highlight bars are NOT one uniform box — each strip is a different length matching the text, irregular stacked horizontal strips, tight leading, deliberately imperfect editorial composition.

Below the highlighted block: a very thin light-gray horizontal rule starting at the same left margin, about 80–85% of the available width.

The bottom third of the image is empty dark charcoal. Quiet literary poster, not conventional advertising.
Brand is Orlis (O-r-l-i-s), never Skool, never poet.
